prompt: Add the person from #product-growth who isn't already part of any of our other team channels to #core-infra as well — they'll need infra visibility for the upcoming launch.
binding_note: Per the route contract, r0 (users) is identified through r1 (channel_members) binding r0.user_id, r1 joining to r2 (channels) via channel_id, and r2 joining to r3 (teams) via team_id. The identifying condition requires r0 to hold a channel_members row (r1) whose channel (r2) is #product-growth within the workspace (r3, T01WORKSPACE), while r0 must lack any such channel_members row whose channel (a distinct r2 instance) is #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, or #project-alpha-dev in that same workspace. These are separate r1/r2 instances per excluded channel; none is required to coincide with the product-growth membership record beyond sharing r0 and r3.

obligations.name: identify_isolated_growth_member
obligations.description: Select the single user (r0) whose channel_members rows within workspace T01WORKSPACE join only to #product-growth and to none of #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, or #project-alpha-dev.
obligations.scope: channel_members rows bounded to workspace T01WORKSPACE's named channel corpus (#product-growth, #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, #project-alpha-dev)

obligations.name: invite_to_core_infra
obligations.description: Create a channel_members row pairing the identified user with #core-infra, adding the previously absent membership.
obligations.scope: one new membership row linking the identified user to the #core-infra channel

task_spec.text: Find the product-growth channel member who has no membership in any other team channel within the workspace.
Invite that identified person into the #core-infra channel.

access_plan: Use conversations.members on #product-growth (C_GROWTH) to enumerate its membership, then cross-check each member against conversations.members results for #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, and #project-alpha-dev (the bounded, visible channel-ID corpus of workspace T01WORKSPACE) to find the one member absent from all of them. Then call conversations.invite on #core-infra with that user's ID to create the new channel_members row.
